question.text: Operational risk is the risk of losses from:

answer.text: Inadequate or failed policies, processes, systems and people

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook defines operational risk as potential losses due to inadequate or failed policies, processes, systems and people. The Trap: Market, credit and currency exposures are separate risk categories distinct from operational risk. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers workbook, p.283-284.
